race.description: Debortoli Limoncello Spritz Country Boosted Hcp (C3)
race.comment: RICH STAR (1) above-average gelding with his hoof on the till third up. Collared late second up with a game on speed second over 1010m at Coffs Harbour. Will slide across from the sticky gate and prove hard to get past with the 3kg claimer aboard. BROKEN WINGS (6) has been thereabouts of late and will appreciate the firmer track. Closed quickly with a narrow third over 1000m at this track. Has a good record here and can take a hand in the finish. EX WIFE (4) returned from a long layoff with a respectable third over 1010m at Coffs Harbour in this class. Undefeated in two attempts at this track and will need a good ride from the gate. Each-way. PRATT (2) sat on the fast tempo second up from the awkward draw with a tiring sixth in a C3 at Coffs Harbour over 1010m. Maps well and capable of better.
